versionFieldNote: Only allowlistVersion is machine-checked against the allowlist, README and CHANGELOG (verify_all.py allowlist_version_parity). pageSpecVersion is enforced inside PageSpecs (schema const 2.0.0); nothing checks this manifest copy against it. repositoryVersion is documentation-only and hand-maintained. The counts block IS machine-checked (recomputed from disk by verify_all.py).
statusNote: Not approved for production. The source is a real, live company's site: do not publish this package or make any repository holding it public.

modes.clone: faithful Equator reconstruction; real assets/copy allowed as evidence
modes.generation: a page for another organisation; every Equator brand/person/customer/copy/claim/URL/embed/asset is rejected (GENERATION_MODE_*)

designPolicy.contentHashScope: sha256 over policy/design-policy.json enforcedBy files (extraction/policy_hash.py); verify_all.py check design_policy recomputes it.

source.originalStack: Nuxt 3 / Vue 3, Locomotive Scroll v5 (Lenis 1.1.9), dotlottie-web 0.54.1, vue3-carousel, marquee3k
source.gitNote: The source project is a git repository. design-repo.zip is listed in .gitignore and is never committed next to the live design-repo/ folder.

knownLimitations: template.not-found / route * / content.not-found are inferred-unmeasured: NotFound.jsx was added after QA and never compared with the original's Nuxt 404.
reducedMotionFallback values are prescriptive: the source has no prefers-reduced-motion handling.
Lottie and video artwork is canvas/video content and was never measured; it is also policy must-not-reproduce / may-generate-new-only.
Known accessibility parity defects are preserved as source-site behaviour (see sections/capabilities.accordion.json, team.roster.json, chrome.header.json).

Generation-mode leakage detection is string-based on normalised text (hashed 5-word shingles, regexes from the real source). No human has reviewed the patterns; paraphrase, translation or text inside images evade it.
Visual parity of the clone against the live site was not re-measured in this revision; only section heights of the built clone at 1440px were measured.
The design-policy binding and the splash retrieval-ineligibility are agent attestation, not a human sign-off; policyDecision is defined-pending-architecture-review.
